messages:
karen: Need a compact launch snapshot for field: single-sheet that covers security controls, SLA tiers, deploy modes, one conservative benchmark callout, and a copyable inbound-routing rule + two email subject lines for SDRs. Target: webinar landing + AE one-pager.

pete: Outline idea: hero sentence, 3 security bullets (BYOK/HSM, regional residency, audit logs), SLA bullets, 3-line deploy-mode matrix, benchmark blurb, routing snippet, CTAs.

ana: Benchmark suggestion (conservative): "Ded. pool mixed-gen: p50~32ms, p95~95ms, p99~180ms. Typical caching reduces repeated-prefix token spend ~35%. Results vary by model and prompt patterns."

soph: Two headline options for A/B: 1) "Predictable inference for regulated teams" 2) "Secure, SLA-backed LLM serving". Vote in thread pls.

owen: Routing pseudo-rule (copy-ready):
```
if lead.industry in ["healthcare","finance","gov"] or lead.tags contains "regulated":
  assign.queue = "enterprise-sdr"
  lead.priority = "high"
  add.tags = ["enterprise","compliance"]
  if lead.estimated_monthly_tokens > 2000000:
    escalate_to = "solutions-arch"
```

ana: Add webhook demo example: POST /hooks/demo-request body {company, use_case, compliance_needs, expected_monthly_tokens}.

pete: Email subjects: 1) "[Company] + Redwood: Secure LLM serving for regulated workflows" 2) "Quick call? SLA-backed inference for [Company]"

soph: Vote: I pick 2. cleaner in field.

karen: Ownership: pete finalize copy + benchmark note; ana verify infra numbers; soph prepare webinar landing headline and register slot. automation-bot: draft_saved: https://drive.company/redwood/marketing/deploy-decision-snapshot-v1 :white_check_mark:

karen: Thanks team — aim to lock copy by EOD and publish to field kit tomorrow.
